name: The Dells
description: Farming country of the High Marks, including the Western Dells, which the Engineers treat as their own. Farm produce is its main export; rural communities resist foreign influence. Terrain die 2.

name: The Black Dunes
description:
Volcanic sands, highly rich in ore, once sacred land to the True Church. The Engineers have claimed them. Terrain die 4.

On the world globe (pole 50.27°E 10°S, seam 150°E 50°S, south compression 0.5, E/W 0.55), remapped Burgas sits at about 27.4°N 10.6°W. The globe's tilted climate axis gives it a climate latitude of about 46°: cold, at the edge of the ice belt, and moderately dry (much of the land within 8° is land). Real east now points west-north-west here, so the real Black Sea coast faces west. Physically, think of the Kamchatka Peninsula: volcanoes, glaciers and black volcanic sand, though drier.

name: The Enclave
description: The Committee Exterior's enclave in the dunes.

name: Clockwork Den
description: The Artificer's Workshop: a rare Engineer workshop with tightly controlled tradecraft, north of the river between the dunes and the Dells.

name: Hearth
description: Capital of the region: a stronghold where the rivers meet, hospitable to all comers.

name: The Bonefort
description: The True Church's strongest base in the Marks: as close as there is to a True Church capital. On the rocky coast south of the Fist of Glass. Its coast is the remapped Black Sea coast near Burgas.

name: Volcano, Valleys and Glaciers
description: Snow-capped mountains around an active volcano, cut by glaciers and valleys. When it snows here, the flakes are warm and dry. Terrain die 6.

name: Cannerly Hall
description: Known locally as Mouldy Manor. East of Hearth, across the river.

name: The Tomb of Incentus I
description: The tomb of Incentus I, Lord of the Dells.

name: Candlesham
description: A port city of Miurna.

name: The Bakery at Candlesham
description: The Order of the White Raven's main safehouse and almshouse, where it gathers messages and donations. A closely guarded secret.

name: The Raven of Carrowmore
description: A public house in Linos whose sign is a white raven; where the Order of the White Raven was founded.

name: The Sea
description: The sea to the west of the Dells.

name: Fist of Glass
description: A cluster of rocks off the western coast.

name: Forest of Arrows
description: Dense forest along the north-western coast.

name: Great Stone Face
description: A landmark in the mountains north-east of Hearth.

name: Engineers' Trading Post
description: A waypoint at the river crossing by the Dead Aqueduct: timber buildings, stalls and yards around a large warehouse.

name: The Warehouse
description: The trading post's great warehouse, among the stalls and timber yards.

name: Dead Aqueduct
description: A stone aqueduct bridge over the river beside the trading post, now its crossing.

name: Ancient Channel
description: Unexplained phenomena: a braided web of channels spreading south of the Dead Aqueduct.

name: The Farmlands
description: Small fields on the coastal plain south of the dunes. Terrain die 3.

name: River of Sulphur
description: Runs from the volcano.
